title: Emergency Session: Lawsuits & Power Company
summary:
*   An emergency special meeting was convened, held entirely in a private executive session.
*   Closed-door discussions focused on pending litigation, including two active lawsuits.
*   A primary subject of the litigation was disputes involving Houston Lighting & Power Company.
*   No public action or decisions were announced following the executive session.
transcript:
March 16, 1985 - 10:00 A.M.- EMERGENCY SPECIAL MEETING - THIRD FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM,
MUNICIPAL BUILDING Mayor Mullen called to order the emergency special meeting of the
Council* noting the absence of Council(, member Spaeth. Purpose of the meeting was to go
into an executive session.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
Mayor Mullen announced Council would go into Executive Session, pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss the following matter; and
action. If any, on the matter will be taken during the public meeting after the conclusion
of the Executive Session: Pending Litigation, Including but not limited to the following
Items - Section 2, Paragraph e Houston Lighting & Power Company, et al v.
Brown and Root, et al In Matagorda County, and City of Austin vs. Houston Lighting and
Power Company in Travis County - Section 2, Paragraph e.
Council took no public action as a result of the Executive Session.
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 3:00 P.M.
